Program Title: Postgraduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling
Level: Diploma / Certificate
Faculty / College: Faculty of Engineering & Technology
Department: SRM-DBT Platform
Campuses Available: Kattankulathur (KTR)
Duration: 1
Sanctioned Intake: 10 seats
Annual Tuition Fees: INR 70,000 (70000)
Campus-Specific Offerings:
- Campus: Kattankulathur (KTR) | Intake: 10 | Fee: 70000 | Duration: 1
Eligibility & Admission Criteria: MSc/BE/BTech in any branch of life sciences, or an undergraduate degree in medical, dental, alternative medicine, or allied health sciences, or an equivalent qualification, with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks in the qualifying examination. Candidates with a higher degree in these disciplines are also eligible. Preference will be given to candidates with a background in genetics or clinical sciences and/or work experience in hospitals or support groups for genetic diseases.
Program Overview & Curriculum: The Postgraduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling at SRM Institute of Science and Technology is designed to equip students with the knowledge and practical skills required to guide individuals and families through genetic testing, diagnosis, and inherited health conditions. The programme integrates concepts of human genetics, genomics, counselling techniques, ethics, and clinical applications, preparing graduates to support informed healthcare decisions and contribute effectively to the growing field of precision medicine and genetic healthcare.
Official URL: https://www.srmist.edu.in/program/postgraduate-diploma-in-genetic-counselling/

Level: Doctoral / Ph.D.
Faculty / College: Faculty of Engineering & Technology
Department: Department of Biotechnology
Campuses Available: Kattankulathur(KTR)
Duration: 3-5 Years
Annual Tuition Fees: INR 10,000 (INR 10,000)
Campus-Specific Offerings:
- Campus: Kattankulathur(KTR) | Fee: INR 10,000 | Duration: 3-5 Years
Eligibility & Admission Criteria: A 1-year/2-semester master’s degree programme after a 4-year/8-semester bachelor’s degree programme or a 2-year/4-semester master’s degree programme after a 3-year bachelor’s degree programme or qualifications declared equivalent to the master’s degree by the corresponding statutory regulatory body, with at least 55% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed or equivalent qualification from a foreign educational institution accredited by an assessment and accreditation agency which is approved, recognized or authorized by an authority, established or incorporated under a law in its home country or any other statutory authority in that country to assess, accredit or assure quality and standards of the educational institution. A candidate seeking admission after a 4-year/8-semester bachelor’s degree programme should have obtained the degree, First Class with Distinction, and a minimum of 75% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. And qualification in any of the UGC-NET/UGC- CSIR NET/GATE/CEED and similar National level tests is mandatory. Application The candidates desirous of pursuing PhD degree shall submit the application in the prescribed form through online portal before the deadline notified in SRMIST website. The application form and the necessary details are available on the SRMIST website. The PhD admission happens two times per year (June and December). AICTE – QIP Minor center for PhD programs: AICTE has granted approval for starting of a new QIP centre (Minor) PhD programme at Department of Biotechnology, School of Bioengineering, SRMIST Sanctioned Seats– 2 – The candidate should possess: Three years of teaching experience at graduate/polytechnic level. A Master’s degree in the appropriate branch – The candidate, if selected and admitted, should be on deputation and his/her normal salary and allowances are to be paid by the parent institution. – The candidate selected for admission under QIP will have to execute an undertaking to serve his/her parent institution for a minimum period of three years after completion of the program. – The candidate shall be willing to complete either 3rd or 4th semester (if allotted) at a foreign university as directed by the host QIP Center. Assistance to QIP Engineering Scheme for PhD Degree Programme – Scholarship – Rs.15,000/- P.M (for 3 year).
Official URL: https://www.srmist.edu.in/program/phd-in-biotechnology/

Eligibility & Admission Criteria: Master of Public Health or an equivalent degree from a recognized University
Program Overview & Curriculum: The School of Public Health offers a full-time Ph.D. program. Candidates are selected on the basis of a written exam and the presentation of their research proposal. Upon selection and enrollment, candidates complete two mandatory core courses focused on research methods and research and publication ethics. Subsequently, they engage in two elective courses aligned with their chosen topic of research. Following a comprehensive viva examination, candidates finalize the research topic. Studying the selected topic thoroughly, they undertake research to answer the identified research questions. Each candidate is required to publish a minimum of two research articles annually in Scopus/ wos journals and to present their work at conferences. Based on successful defense of the research findings before a doctoral committee, the candidate is conferred with a Ph.D. Subject to available vacancies, entrance examinations for admission to Ph.D. are conducted twice a year. Full-time Ph.D. scholars may qualify for institutional fellowship support of Rs. 25,000 per month. The minimum duration for the program is three years.
Official URL: https://www.srmist.edu.in/program/ph-d-public-health/

The course focuses on constitutional law, corporate law, cyber law, intellectual property rights, human rights, and interdisciplinary legal studies. Scholars work under experienced faculty guidance and contribute through research publications, seminars, and thesis work. The programme prepares candidates for careers in academia, legal consultancy, policy research, and judicial or corporate legal sectors.

It offers a blend of technical knowledge, financial expertise, and innovation-driven skills, opening diverse career paths in a dynamic and high-growth industry. Fintech is considered as a separate important vertical with lot of application development happening in the sector with advanced technologies. M.Tech in Financial Technologies integrates finance with cutting-edge technology, covering blockchain, AI, big data, cybersecurity, and cloud computing. It focuses on digital payments, algorithmic trading, RegTech, and financial analytics, preparing students for innovation in banking, investments, and insurance. The proposed degree bridge the gap between computing and finance, fostering innovation and meeting industry needs. This program will equip students with cutting-edge skills, enhancing employability in banking, fintech startups, and regulatory sectors. Graduates are eligible to gain employment as consultants in Private practice,professional members in large and small academic organizations, Leader Managers inHuman service organizations, Faculty in Higher Education and principal investigator inResearch Projects. Program Overview & Curriculum: The B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) aims to produce leaders who will be at the forefront of research, development, and innovation in futuristic disciplines and next-generation technologies that require deep use of mathematics, computer science, and data science. This multidisciplinary program equips students with essential analytical, computational, and problem-solving skills, enabling them to tackle complex real-world challenges. The curriculum covers core subjects such as Calculus, Linear Algebra, Discrete Mathematics, Probability and Statistics, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Computer Architecture. Additionally, students explore advanced topics like Machine Learning, Cryptography, Cyber-Physical Systems, and Virtual Computing, allowing them to specialize in cutting-edge technologies. The program emphasizes hands-on learning through laboratory sessions, research projects, and industry collaborations, ensuring graduates are well-prepared for the evolving tech landscape. Graduates of this program have diverse career opportunities in fields such as Software Development, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Financial Engineering, Cryptography, Cybersecurity, and Computational Research. They can work as Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Quantitative Analysts, Software Developers, Research Scientists, Cybersecurity Analysts, and Algorithm Designers in industries like IT, FinTech, Healthcare, Defense, and Scientific Research. The strong mathematical foundation also enables students to pursue higher studies or research in computer science, applied mathematics, and computational sciences, opening avenues in academia and specialized technical roles.
Official URL: https://www.srmist.edu.in/program/b-tech-mathematics-and-computing/
